title: Service status and outage communication
body: Check status.example.com. P0 incidents get a status page post within 15 minutes. Platform-wide outages are owned by the Infrastructure team.

title: Resetting SSO / SAML configuration
body: SSO misconfiguration locks out all users of an org. Admins can use the break-glass login link. Owned by the Identity team.

title: Refunds and invoice corrections
body: Refunds within 30 days are approved by Billing. Duplicate charges are refunded automatically within 5 business days.

title: Export to CSV and PDF
body: Exports over 50k rows run asynchronously and are emailed. Known issue: PDF export fails for dashboards with more than 20 widgets.

title: API rate limits
body: Pro: 600 requests/minute. Enterprise: custom limits. 429 responses include a Retry-After header.

title: Data deletion and GDPR requests
body: Deletion requests are fulfilled within 30 days by the Trust team. Enterprise DPAs may require 7-day turnaround.

title: Mobile app sync issues
body: Sync failures on mobile are usually caused by an expired session. Reinstalling does not help; sign out and back in. Owned by the Mobile team.

title: Feature requests
body: Feature requests are logged by Support in the product board and acknowledged within 2 business days.

title: Webhooks and integrations
body: Webhook deliveries retry 5 times with exponential backoff. Slack and Jira integrations are owned by the Integrations team.
